title: End-to-end external surface-water exchange transaction
purpose: Qualify one origin-bound coupled transaction in which accepted Ribasim surface-water state supplies the control head, SWAP computes a signed exchange request, Ribasim realizes the physical transfer subject to availability, and both sides commit exactly once only when the realized transfer and accepted origins are mutually consistent.

authorities.swap_process: SW-RIB-SWM01 Q4B signed extended exchange runtime binding

G5A_ORIGIN_BOUND_TRANSACTION.objective: Qualify typed origin identity, nonmutating candidate evaluation, stale-origin rejection, retry determinism and recomposition state machine independently of product execution.

G5B_EXACT_RELEASE_REALIZATION.objective: Use exact-release Ribasim to realize the frozen positive, sufficient-negative and availability-limited-negative cases, then feed the resulting receipt into the G5A transaction state machine.

cases.expected: realized equals requested; one joint commit; both accepted revisions advance exactly once
realized equals requested; one joint commit; exactly-once opposite-sign booking

first candidate does not commit; realized transfer differs from requested; disposition RECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED; both models restart from unchanged accepted origins; recomposed candidate may commit only with the realized transfer
receipt or candidate bound to a stale SWAP or Ribasim revision fails closed with no commit
same accepted origins and identical external inputs reproduce identical request, realization receipt and recomposition disposition

hard_invariants: Requested transfer is never accepted physical mass by itself.
Ribasim realized transfer is authoritative for external physical mass.
If requested and realized differ, neither side may commit the first candidate.
Recomposition starts from the exact same accepted SWAP and Ribasim origins.
No accepted state changes on rejection.
Exactly one accepted transfer identity is booked on SWAP and Ribasim with opposite signs.
A stale origin revision fails closed.
Accepted external head snapshot revision must match the Ribasim origin used by the realization receipt.
forbidden: accept SWAP requested infiltration then clip only Ribasim
reuse a trial Ribasim head as accepted control input
mix a realization receipt from one Ribasim revision with a SWAP candidate from another coupled origin
book both requested and realized transfer
unit_clarification: Frozen E1/E2/E3 quantities 0.01, 0.005 and 0.0051 are physical transfer volumes in m3 for the 1 m2 one-day research profile, not centimetres.
